name: AXN aliases
description: Every prior form of an archive AXN, each mapped to the record it names and that record's current AXN. A prior form is a full AXN string the record once carried: a batch assignment of 2026-06-20, an AXN derived from an earlier state of the text, or a glyph string not derived with the canonical table. The hex position never changes; the glyphs follow the record's bytes.
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-27: "axns should match their records" — "1. all 762." — "2. leave as is as long as old axns resolve correctly." — "fill the two."
